metric_contract.name: Recall
metric_contract.formula: Manual User Story rows that have at least one generated match, divided by the count of manual User Story rows.

metric_contract.name: Precision
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows matched to a manual story, divided by (those matches + generated-only rows classified noise). Valid extras are excluded from the denominator.

metric_contract.name: Manual-only Stories
metric_contract.formula: Count of manual User Story rows with no generated match. The report lists each row with a transcript reference.

metric_contract.name: Generated-only Stories (Valid Extras vs Noise)
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows with no manual match. valid_extra: the transcript states the requirement and the manual CSV does not. noise: the transcript does not state the requirement, or the row restates no distinct requirement. Classification must cite hallucination-detection-evaluator evidence. Disagreement between the two subagents is BLOCKED_CONFLICT, not an average.

metric_contract.name: Epic Agreement
metric_contract.formula: Matched pairs whose epic context agrees, divided by matched pairs where both sides have an epic context (preceding Epic row, else blank). Agree when Epic ID is equal and non-blank, or when both IDs are blank and the Epic titles are the same string. Pairs with epic context on only one side count as disagree. Zero comparable pairs → na.

metric_contract.name: Feature Agreement
metric_contract.formula: Matched pairs whose feature context agrees, divided by matched pairs where both sides have a feature context (preceding Feature row, or the User Story ID when that ID is the catalog Feature work item id). Agree when Feature ID is equal and non-blank, or when both IDs are blank and the Feature titles are the same string. One-sided context counts as disagree. Zero comparable pairs → na.

metric_contract.name: Title and Description Format Compliance
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows whose Title is a short capability name (does not start with "As a") and whose Description matches "As a <role>, I need to <need>, so that <benefit>." divided by generated User Story rows. Pattern source: docs/intake/user-story-csv-rulebook.yaml title_formats.user_story and user_story.description_format. The prepare packet's structural signal is the default numerator; override only with a cited finding.

metric_contract.name: Role Specificity
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows whose captured role is a business role, divided by generated User Story rows.

metric_contract.name: Acceptance Criteria Count
metric_contract.formula: Mean number of Acceptance Criteria bullets on manual User Story rows and on generated User Story rows, plus both totals. A bullet is a non-empty line in the Acceptance Criteria cell.

metric_contract.name: Acceptance Criteria Quality
metric_contract.formula: Mean of per-story quality scores on generated User Story rows. A bullet scores only when it is one observable outcome, testable from the transcript, and the cell uses ASCII "- " bullets (rulebook acceptance_criteria.format). Score is 0-100. Do not award points for implementation detail.

metric_contract.name: Negative and Boundary Coverage
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows whose Acceptance Criteria include the negative or boundary outcome the transcript states for that requirement, divided by generated User Story rows whose matched transcript span states a negative or boundary. When the transcript states none, na.

metric_contract.name: Granularity
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows that state exactly one capability, divided by generated User Story rows. A split or merge recorded on a match is evidence of a granularity miss for every generated row in that match that stacks or fragments a capability.

metric_contract.name: Hallucination Rate
metric_contract.formula: Generated User Story rows that contain at least one claim the transcript does not support, divided by generated User Story rows. Every counted row needs a transcript locator showing the absence of support (the nearest related span, or an explicit note that no span exists). Unsupported epic or feature titles count as hallucinations.

manual_stories.title: Define External Analytics Data Sources and Requirements
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Data Administrator, 

I should , define the approved external analytics platforms, datasets, events, attributes, history, refresh frequency, 

So that only relevant data is brought into Customer Insights - Data.
acceptance_criteria:
1. All relevant analytics platforms are identified.
2. Required datasets, events, dimensions, measures, and historical periods are documented.
3. Batch and real-time ingestion requirements are classified.
4. Required refresh frequency and data volume estimates are documented.
5. Customer-identification fields and matching keys are identified.
6. Reporting, segmentation, and journey-activation use cases are documented.
7. Business and technical owners approve the source inventory and requirements.

manual_stories.title: Map External Analytics Data to the Customer Insights Data Model
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Data Administrator, 

I should map external analytics data to the appropriate Customer Insights entities and attributes,

So that digital behavior can be consistently interpreted and used across customer profiles, segments, and analytics.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Source-to-target mappings are documented for all approved fields.
2. Customer identifiers, event types, timestamps, channels, campaigns attributes are mapped.
3. Data types and formats are standardized.
4. Mandatory mapping validations are applied.
5. Sample source records are validated against the resulting Customer Insights records.
6. Business owners approve the meaning and usage of key analytics attributes.

manual_stories.title: Configure Scheduled Batch Analytics Data Ingestion
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Data Administrator, 

I should configure scheduled batch ingestion of external analytics data, 

so that customer behavior, engagement, and conversion information is refreshed at an agreed frequency.
acceptance_criteria:
1. The batch ingestion frequency is defined and configured. 
2. The process imports only the approved datasets and historical range. 
3. Incremental ingestion or another approved loading approach is implemented. 
4. Duplicate ingestion is prevented or managed. 
5. Successful and unsuccessful batch executions can be monitored. 
6. Refreshed data becomes available for downstream profile and segment processing.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. The batch ingestion frequency is defined and configured. 
2. The process imports only the approved datasets and historical range. 
3. Incremental ingestion or another approved loading approach is implemented. 
4. Duplicate ingestion is prevented or managed. 
5. Successful and unsuccessful batch executions can be monitored. 
6. Refreshed data becomes available for downstream profile and segment processing.

manual_stories.title: Implement Real-Time Behavioral Data Ingestion
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should receive approved digital behavioral events, 

so that time-sensitive engagement signals can support customer analysis, segmentation, and journey activation.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Real-time business use cases and eligible event types are approved. 
2. The source, integration platform, event schema, expected volume, and latency are defined. 
3. Event validation and duplicate-event handling are implemented. 
4. Successfully processed events are available in the target analytical environment.

manual_stories.title: Associate Identifiable Digital Behavior with Customer Profiles
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Analyst,

I should associate identifiable digital interactions with the correct customer or contact profile, 

so that I can understand individual engagement and create behavior-based audiences within the customer insights unified profile
acceptance_criteria:
1. Identifiable events are associated with the correct unified customer profile. 
2. A single event is not incorrectly associated with multiple profiles.
3. Match confidence and exception-handling rules are defined. 
4. Matched behavioral activities are visible against the appropriate profile.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. Identifiable events are associated with the correct unified customer profile. 
2. A single event is not incorrectly associated with multiple profiles.
3. Match confidence and exception-handling rules are defined. 
4. Matched behavioral activities are visible against the appropriate profile.

manual_stories.title: Unify External Analytics Data with Customer and Engagement Data
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Analyst, 

I should be able to unify external analytics data together with customer, account and engagement information, 

so that I can analyze the customer using a consolidated profile.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved analytics data is included in the Customer Insights unification process. 
2. Required customer, account, and interaction relationships are configured. 
3. Duplicate customer profiles are handled according to approved rules. 
4. Unified profiles display the agreed digital-engagement indicators. 
5. Profile refresh completes according to the agreed schedule.

manual_stories.title: Create Customer Measures from External Analytics Data
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Analyst, 

I should calculate reusable customer measures from digital analytics and behavioral data, 

so that customer engagement and digital activity can be consistently analyzed and used for targeting.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Priority customer measures are defined and approved.
2. Calculation logic and lookback periods are documented. 
3. Measures refresh with the relevant source data. 
4. Calculated values are available on the appropriate customer profiles. 
5. Measures can be used in segments where supported. 
6. Results are validated against representative source data.

manual_stories.title: Make Unified Analytics Data Available for Journey Activation
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should use approved analytics-based segments and engagement signals in Customer Insights - Journeys, 

so that campaign audiences and communications reflect recent digital behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved analytics-driven segments are available to Customer Insights - Journeys. 
2. Segment membership is transferred within the agreed refresh timeframe. 
3. Consent and communication preferences are evaluated before activation. 
4. Test profiles validate expected journey entry behavior. 
5. Journey interactions remain traceable to the activated audience.

manual_stories.title: Monitor Analytics Data Ingestion and Processing
manual_stories.description:
As a Data Operations User, 

I should monitor external analytics ingestion, processing, and refresh activities, 

so that failures and data-quality issues can be identified and resolved before they affect segmentation or reporting.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Ingestion execution status is available to authorized users.
2. Source and target record counts can be reviewed. 
3. Alerts Indications are generated for failures. 
4. Failed data can be corrected and reprocessed.

manual_stories.title: Validate External Analytics Data Quality
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Data Administrator, 

I should validate the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of external analytics data, 

so that marketing analysis and segmentation are based on reliable information.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Data quality of External Analytics Data can be validated and tracked for errors
2. Invalid and incomplete records are identified. 
2. Duplicate-event controls are implemented. 
3. Data recency and refresh completion are monitored. 
4. Quality exceptions are reported to the responsible owner.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. Data quality of External Analytics Data can be validated and tracked for errors
2. Invalid and incomplete records are identified. 
2. Duplicate-event controls are implemented. 
3. Data recency and refresh completion are monitored. 
4. Quality exceptions are reported to the responsible owner.

manual_stories.title: Access External Analytics Data for Marketing Out of Box Reporting
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Analyst, 

I should be able to access OOB analytics data for reporting, 

so that I can evaluate customer behavior, channel engagement, campaign effectiveness, and conversion trends.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Reporting-ready analytics datasets and measures are identified. 
2. Standard Customer Insights analytics are used where they meet the requirement. 
3. Reported totals are reconciled with the approved source or unified dataset.

manual_stories.title: Configure Access to Approved Marketing Assets from MediaValet
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should be able to access approved marketing assets from MediaValet while building marketing communications,

 so that only approved content is used in customer-facing campaigns and journeys.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved assets are available to marketing users in media valet. 
2. Users can identify approved content versions. 
3. Marketers can locate required assets efficiently.

manual_stories.title: Create Marketing Email Templates Using Approved Assets
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should be able to create reusable email templates using approved MediaValet content, 

so that campaigns can be launched quickly while maintaining consistency.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Email templates can be created using available assets. 
2. Branding standards are maintained. 
3. Templates support personalization fields. 
4. Templates can be previewed and tested. 
5. Templates can be reused across campaigns. 
6. Only authorized users can publish templates.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. Email templates can be created using available assets. 
2. Branding standards are maintained. 
3. Templates support personalization fields. 
4. Templates can be previewed and tested. 
5. Templates can be reused across campaigns. 
6. Only authorized users can publish templates.

manual_stories.title: Create Campaign Landing Pages Using Approved Assets
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should be able to build landing pages using approved content and imagery, 

so that campaign audiences receive consistent information and messaging.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Landing pages support approved content. 
2. Branding guidelines are maintained. 
3. Forms can be embedded where required. 
4. Landing page interactions are trackable. 
5. Pages can be previewed before activation. 
6. Pages can be associated with campaigns and journeys.

manual_stories.title: Create Marketing Forms for Campaign Responses
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should configure marketing forms,

so that campaign responses and customer interest can be captured and tracked.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Forms capture agreed business information. 
2. Mandatory-field validation is supported. 
3. Form responses are recorded successfully. 
4. Consent center / preference center link is included where required. 
5. Submitted responses are available for downstream processing.

manual_stories.title: Configure Personalized Marketing Content
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should be able to personalize marketing communications using customer profile information, 

so that marketing messages are more relevant to recipients.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Personalization fields are supported in email and sms 
2. Customer attributes can be inserted into communications. 
3. Preview and testing functionality is available. 
4. Missing data handling is defined. 
5. Personalization works consistently across journeys. 
6. Personalized communications are delivered successfully.

manual_stories.title: Configure Audience-Specific Content Variations
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should be able to deliver different approved content variations to specific audiences,
 
so that communications remain relevant across customer groups and markets.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Multiple approved content variations can be configured. 
2. Audience assignment rules are supported. 
3. Correct variations are delivered to intended audiences. 
4. Variations can be tested prior to activation. 
5. Default content behavior is defined. 
6. Engagement reporting remains available by variation.

manual_stories.title: Support Product Launch Communications
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should deliver launch-related communications using approved launch content, 

so that customers, partners, and stakeholders receive timely product information.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved launch content is available for activation. 
2. Launch audiences can be segmented. 
3. Product launch journeys can be configured. 
4. Launch communications can be tested. 
5. Delivery status is measurable. 
6. Engagement metrics are available.

manual_stories.title: Support Service and Solution Communications
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should deliver service and solution communications using approved content, 

so that customers receive consistent information regarding products, services, and solutions.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved service content is available. 
2. Relevant audiences can be identified. 
3. Communications can be launched through journeys. 
4. Customer interactions are measurable. 
5. Communication history is retained. 
6. Reporting is available.

manual_stories.title: Support Multi-Region Marketing Communications
manual_stories.description:
As a Global Marketer, 

I should activate communications across multiple regions, 

so that regional marketing teams can execute campaigns using a common approach.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Regional audiences can be identified. 
2. Regional content variations can be configured. 
3. Regional delivery schedules are supported. 
4. Communications comply with applicable regional settings. 
5. Results can be filtered by region.
6. Regional activation can be governed centrally.

manual_stories.title: Support Multi-Language Marketing Communications
manual_stories.description:
As a Global Marketer, 

I should deliver communications in multiple languages, 

so that recipients receive messages in their preferred language where supported.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Multiple language versions can be configured. 
2. Language selection rules are supported. 
3. Communications display correctly in supported languages. 
4. Language-specific previews are available. 
5. Engagement can be measured by language. 
6. Fallback language rules are defined.

manual_stories.title: Track Content Utilization Across Marketing Activities
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,  

I should understand where approved content is being used, 

so that content reuse and effectiveness can be monitored.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Content usage can be traced across campaigns and journeys. e.g emails, SMS's, Marketing forms, Landing pages etc
2. Frequently used assets can be identified. 
3. Reporting is available for content utilization.

manual_stories.title: Measure Content Engagement Performance
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager, 

I should measure engagement against content delivered through campaigns and journeys, 

so that future communications can be optimized.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Open, click, and engagement metrics are available on emails. 
2. Results can be reviewed by content asset or communication. 
3. Performance trends can be analyzed. 
4. Low-performing content can be identified. 
5. Reporting is available to authorized users.

manual_stories.title: Ingest Internal Source Data into Customer Insights - Data
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Data Administrator, 

I should ingest customer, order, shipment, partner and eCommerce data from the agreed internal sources into Customer Insights - Data,

So that unified profiles and segments are built on the data the business trusts.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Release-1 source systems are confirmed (CRM, F&O orders and shipments, Zinfi partner data, eCommerce). 
2. Required tables and attributes are identified for each source. 
3. Connections and refresh schedules are configured. 
4. Loaded record counts are reconciled to the source. 
5. Account and contact relationships are preserved, so the profile is account-level with contact drill-down. 
6. Failed refreshes are visible to administrators. 
7. Ingested data is available for unification.

manual_stories.title: Configure Branded Sender and Email Domain Authentication
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should send emails from an approved, brand-appropriate sender name on an authenticated domain, 

So that recipients trust and open the email and it reaches the inbox.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved sender names are configured per brand or region (for example a Philips-branded sender where licensed). 
2. Only authorised users can change sender settings. 
3. Sender setup is documented.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. Approved sender names are configured per brand or region (for example a Philips-branded sender where licensed). 
2. Only authorised users can change sender settings. 
3. Sender setup is documented.

manual_stories.title: Define Brand Campaign Audiences
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should identify and create target audiences for brand awareness campaigns, 

so that communications reach the intended customer, partner, and prospect groups.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Audiences can be defined using available segmentation criteria. 
2. Dynamic and static audience selection is supported. 
3. Audience counts can be reviewed prior to activation. 
4. Audience membership can be validated. 
5. Segments can be reused across campaigns. 
6. Audience definitions are available within Customer Insights Journeys.

manual_stories.title: Execute Brand Awareness Communications
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should deliver brand awareness communications to selected audiences, 

so that Heartstream can improve market visibility and audience engagement.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Communications are delivered to the intended audience. 
2. Delivery status is available. 
3. Communication history is retained. 
4. Multiple campaigns can run concurrently. 
5. Communication metrics are captured. 
6. Failed deliveries can be monitored.

manual_stories.title: Configure Event Communication Journeys
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should configure event-related communications, 

so that event invitations, reminders, and follow-up communications can be managed consistently.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Event audiences can be selected. 
2. Invitation and reminder communications are supported. 
3. Event response tracking is available. 
4. Follow-up communications can be configured. 
5. Event communication journeys can be tested. 
6. Engagement metrics are available.

manual_stories.title: Generate Leads from Brand Campaign Activities
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer, 

I should capture leads generated from brand campaign interactions, 

so that interested prospects can enter the lead management process.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Lead capture mechanisms are supported. 
2. Lead source attribution is retained. 
3. Leads are available for qualification. 
4. Campaign association is retained. 
5. Lead generation metrics are available in reporting via dashboard or views etc.

manual_stories.title: Associate Campaign Responses to Customer Profiles
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Analyst, 

I should associate campaign interactions with customer profiles, 

so that future segmentation and engagement analysis can leverage campaign history.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Campaign interactions are associated with customer profiles targeted in Journeys
2. Interaction history is visible. 
3. Historical campaign participation is available.

manual_stories.title: Measure Brand Campaign Performance
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,

I should measure brand campaign performance,

So that the effectiveness of awareness programs can be evaluated.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Standard journey analytics are available.
2. Engagement metrics are visible.
3. Results can be reviewed by campaign.
4. Performance trends can be monitored. 
5. Results are available to authorized users.

manual_stories.title: Provide Brand Campaign Performance Dashboards
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,

I should access campaign performance dashboards,

So that brand campaign effectiveness can be monitored through a single view.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Campaign KPIs are available.
2. Engagement metrics are visible.
3. Dashboard information supports campaign analysis.
4. Users can filter results using agreed dimensions.
5. Data refresh schedules are defined.
6. Access is controlled according to security requirements.

manual_stories.title: Configure Marketing Consent and Subscription Preferences
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should manage customer consent and communication preferences,

So that only eligible recipients receive brand and marketing communications in accordance with their choices and applicable regional requirements.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Consent is configured using the agreed compliance profiles, purposes, and topics.
2. Communication preferences are managed by supported channel and purpose, where applicable.
3. Recipients can update their preferences through the agreed preference-center experience.
4. Unsubscribed or ineligible recipients are excluded from applicable journeys.
5. Consent is evaluated before each communication is sent.
6. Changes to preferences affect subsequent journey eligibility.
7. Consent records and changes are retained for audit and compliance purposes.
8. Regional consent requirements are supported through the agreed compliance-profile design.

manual_stories.title: Verify Campaign Readiness Before Activation
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should verify audience, journey configuration, schedule, and approved content before campaign launch,

So that campaigns are deployed accurately and consistently.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Campaign readiness checklist is completed before activation.
2. Target audience is validated.
3. Journey configuration is reviewed.
4. Content references are confirmed.
5. Schedule is verified.
6. Campaign can proceed to activation only after readiness review.

negative_boundary_signal_lines:
1. Campaign readiness checklist is completed before activation.
2. Target audience is validated.
3. Journey configuration is reviewed.
4. Content references are confirmed.
5. Schedule is verified.
6. Campaign can proceed to activation only after readiness review.

manual_stories.title: Monitor Campaign Readiness and Deployment Status
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,

I should monitor campaigns that are planned, in preparation, active, or completed,

So that campaign execution status remains visible across the marketing organization.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Campaign status is visible.
2. Draft and active campaigns can be distinguished.
3. Campaign schedules are available.
4. Readiness status can be reviewed.
5. Deployment history is retained.
6. Authorized users can access campaign status information.

manual_stories.title: Provide Campaign Governance and Readiness Dashboards
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,

I should access readiness and governance dashboards,

So that campaign preparation and activation activities can be monitored effectively.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Readiness metrics are available via dashboard or views.
2. Planned and active campaigns can be reviewed.
3. Dashboard access is security controlled.

manual_stories.title: Define Marketing Strategy Target Audiences
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Planner,

I should define the customer, account, partner, distributor, market, and regional audiences relevant to a marketing strategy,

So that activation plans are directed toward the intended business populations.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Target-audience criteria can be defined using available customer, account, partner, distributor, geographic, and market attributes.
2. Audience definitions align with the agreed segmentation framework.
3. Audience membership and counts can be reviewed before activation.
4. Audience definitions can be refined as underlying data changes.
5. Authorized users can access and maintain the audience criteria.
6. Approved audiences can be used in Customer Insights - Journeys.

manual_stories.title: Create Strategic Customer and Account Segments
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Planner,

I should create reusable segments for customers and accounts prioritized by the marketing strategy,

So that strategic audiences can be consistently targeted across marketing programs.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Segments can be created using agreed customer and account attributes.
2. Segmentation can consider region, industry, vertical, product ownership, account classification, and engagement where data is available.
3. Segment membership can be previewed and validated.
4. Dynamic segments refresh when underlying data changes.
5. Segment definitions and intended uses are documented.
6. Segments are available for journey activation.

manual_stories.title: Create Strategic Partner and Distributor Segments
manual_stories.description:
As a Channel Marketing Planner,

I should create strategic partner and distributor segments,

So that activation plans can differentiate communications based on partner importance, coverage, performance, and business characteristics.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Partner and distributor data required for segmentation is identified.
2. Segments can use agreed attributes such as partner type, region, tier (if applicable), product portfolio, and performance where available.
3. Strategic distributors can be distinguished from other partners.
4. Partner contacts are associated with the appropriate accounts.
5. Segment membership can be validated and refreshed.
6. Approved segments can be activated through journeys.

manual_stories.title: Configure Strategy-Aligned Customer Journeys
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should configure customer journeys aligned with the approved marketing activation plan,

So that strategic audiences receive the planned communications at the appropriate time.
acceptance_criteria:
1. The journey uses an approved strategic audience or segment.
2. Journey entry, exit, and exclusion criteria are defined.
3. Communication steps, timing, waits, and branches reflect the activation plan.
4. Approved marketing content is used.
5. Consent and communication eligibility are evaluated before delivery.
6. The journey can be previewed, tested, and activated.
7. Journey interactions are captured for measurement.

manual_stories.title: Personalize Communications for Strategic Audiences
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketer,

I should personalize strategy-aligned communications using available customer, account, partner, and audience information,

So that each strategic audience receives relevant messaging.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Approved profile attributes can be used for personalization.
2. Content variations can be configured for defined audiences.
3. Conditional content can be applied where supported.
4. Default content is defined when personalization data is unavailable.
5. Each supported variation can be previewed and tested.
6. Personalization respects consent, privacy, and regional requirements.

manual_stories.title: Activate Marketing Programs Across Priority Markets
manual_stories.description:
As a Global or Regional Marketer,

I should activate marketing programs for selected markets and regions,

So that approved strategies can be executed consistently while accommodating relevant regional differences.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Target markets and regions can be identified using available profile data.
2. Region-specific audiences and schedules can be configured.
3. Approved regional content variations can be used where applicable.
4. Regional consent and communication requirements are applied.
5. Journey execution can be monitored by region or market.
6. Results can be compared across activated markets where data is available.

manual_stories.title: Measure Marketing Activation Plan Performance
manual_stories.description:
As a Marketing Manager,

I should measure audience engagement and journey performance against the intended activation plan,

2. Results can be reviewed by strategic audience, market, region, or program where supported.
3. Delivery, opens, clicks, responses, and available conversion indicators can be monitored.

6. Reporting requirements are supported by available OOB standard analytics provided by system

2. Responding and non-responding audience groups can be identified.
3. Segment criteria can be adjusted using approved engagement indicators.
